localizedText.restoreSymbolAccessOnUpdate: Restore symbol access on symbol update
localizedText.autoSymbolUpdate_description: Automatically checks the PLC for changes and maps the symbols. Mapping of the symbols may take some time. Therefore, for smaller changes on the PLC that do not affect the TcHmiSystemEng.*, it is recommended to set this to false.
localizedText.restoreSymbolAccessOnUpdate_description: Stores all symbol access rights before deletion and restores them automatically after a symbol update wherever possible.
